thread:
Anya: morning — nightly-evals flagged a regression on myanmar_translation (back-translation BLEU drop ~22%). sample below.
Anya: ```
src: မြန်မာစာကို စာပေစာစဉ်တစ်ခုလုံး တင်ပေးပါ။
ref: Please provide the full text in Burmese.
fp16-gen: မြန်မာစာကို တင်ပေးပါ။
int8-gen: မယ္မာစာကို တင်ပေးပါ။  -- tokenization/spacing is corrupted
```
Kai: ack. can you paste eval run id + model hash?
Anya: eval id: nightly-2026-03-18-9134
Anya: model: redwood-v2-instruct-2026-03-17-int8 (quant int8 build)
Anya: fp16 baseline (redwood-v2-instruct-2026-03-16-fp16) doesn't show this. only the quantized build fails.
Mohammed: hmm — looks like tokenization/normalization issue (unicode normalization changed). saw similar for thai where nfkc vs nfc changed grapheme boundaries.
Jessie: is the tokenizer version different between the two builds?
Anya: yes — int8 build used tokenizer v5 (commit 9f3d2b) while fp16 used v4 (commit 7a1b0c).
Kai: can you dump token ids for the Burmese word 'မြန်မာ' across both tokenizers?
Anya: ```
# token id check
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer_v4.json'); print(t.encode('မြန်မာ').ids)"
# -> [1452, 903]
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer_v5.json'); print(t.encode('မြန်မာ').ids)"
# -> [1452, 37, 903]  # extra token inserted due to normalizer change
```
Mohammed: that extra split explains the generation gap — the model's kv cache and positional alignment during quantized kernel math caused the middle token to be mispredicted and spacing to break.
Jessie: could also be that the normalizer changed from NFC -> NFKC in v5. many Myanmar orthographies rely on NFC.
Anya: confirmed: tokenizer_v5.json has "normalizer": "nfkc" while v4 used "nfc". switching back to nfc on a local int8 build fixes the sample.
Kai: nice catch. plan: revert normalizer in tokenizer for next quant build, add a regression test for Burmese/myanmar back-translation, and add a nightly locale smoke test.
Jessie: opened PR #2456: "tokenizer: pin normalizer to nfc for CJK/complex scripts + test". includes CI unit that encodes 10 locale-critical tokens and asserts id stability.
Anya: starting a new quant CI run with reverted normalizer and same seed. @eval-bot run --suite myanmar_backtrans --model redwood-v2-instruct --quant int8 --commit 9f3d2b-revert
eval-bot: Job j-9876 queued — will post results here.
Mohammed: also add a fallback rule in serving: if locale in request in ["my-MM","th-TH","lo-LA"] and quantized build mismatch > X, route to fp16 until CI passes. avoids prod slip.
Kai: agree. file a short RFC for rollout policy? I can draft.
Jessie: will add tests to nightly eval harness: include a small curated Burmese prompt set and require BLEU >= threshold; fail CI on regression.
Anya: re-run completed, j-9876 -> passes locally, BLEU restored. will monitor tomorrow's nightly.
Mohammed: thanks for the quick triage. pro tip: add an automated token-diff check when tokenizer json changes. we've tripped on this twice.
Anya: adding token-diff CI checker to PR template.
Kai: :thumbsup:
Jessie: tagging infra to keep an eye on dedicated GPUs for reruns if needed.
Anya: closing thread after nightly confirms. cheers.
